review: requirements-hardening-244 independent source and bounded-regression review

validation.harness_correction: First supervisor run had 1 FileNotFoundError because snapshot omitted bin/gentle-ai. Copied identical launcher with SHA; all 11 supervisor tests passed on rerun. Original harness error remains in log.
validation.safe_scope: Sequential small owned processes and fixtures; 8MiB allocation rejection only within preexisting process-local 4MiB headroom fixture; no host exhaustion, CI, deployment, platform changes or product edits.

observations.fact: Success limit-observation validation in analyze_logic.main is conditional on _own_cli, while pre-exec worker enforcement is unconditional for both CLI and API. Existing API unit mock returns success without an observation and is accepted.
observations.reachability: No unchanged-production-worker execution reproducing success beyond requested limits was found. Both paths invoke the same run_supervised RLIMIT_AS adapter. Real API observed exact soft/hard448MiB and unchanged caller limits.
observations.assessment: Do not report a confirmed API limit bypass. Making successful-worker observation validation independent of _own_cli would consistently strengthen provenance for both paths and require updating API mocks; currently it is optional hardening pending an explicit identical-observation contract.

observations.fact: Exact solver role is not reduced to fit an inherited lower hard limit. Owned CLI rejects it through enforce_address_space; external API rejects supervisor setup without changing its own limit.
observations.assessment: Consistent with exact provisional profile and no raising inherited hard. Error code differs by failure stage; no requirement for identical codes between these stages was found.

observations.topic: ordinary worker errors and missing observations
observations.fact: The success guard deliberately does not replace INVALID_INPUT, SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE or SOLVER_ERROR with RESOURCE_LIMIT_NOT_OBSERVED when worker returns an error.
observations.assessment: Preserves S3/S4 error contracts. MemoryError diagnostics instead produce INCONCLUSIVE and strip queries/table/coverage; a signal alone remains WORKER_FAILED, not proven OOM.

observations.fact: Linux adapter and baseline/headroom checks fail closed before starting a solver when controls/observations are unavailable. Existing tests mock unsupported adapter and baseline branches.
observations.assessment: No real non-Linux machine was used; cross-platform execution is NOT_RUN. This is no claim of universal recovery or descendant containment.

requirements_assessment.S1: Analyzer/Z3 direct worker receives address_space_limit before exec; model logic remains bounded and existing logical regression tests pass.
requirements_assessment.S2: 512MiB default splits caller64/solver448; totals256..1024 multiple8; Git default dict exact regression passes. Canonical policy validates exact nested types and returns fresh snapshot, so later caller mutation does not change 2x-total headroom. Git/logic share same per-UID nonblocking lease. Caller limit changes only for owned CLI, with measured baseline; API real calls preserve limits.
requirements_assessment.S3: Observed Python MemoryError branches return fixed INCONCLUSIVE/no-coverage payload. Resource rejection yields INCONCLUSIVE. Signals/missing diagnostics are not called OOM. Observations distinguish virtual/RSS/peak lifetime and do not assert aggregate RSS quota or calibrated hardware capacity.
requirements_assessment.S4: 72 relevant tests pass, including logical/argument/error/AST/bytes/deadline regressions. Admission elapsed time is subtracted and command setup checked again before spawning. No release-doc version claim or RDD approval inferred from this independent subset.

not_run: arbitrary descendant or native-failure universal containment
cleanup: Snapshot can be deleted after parent captures report; no child remains owned by this review.
